build_spec.purpose: To automate and streamline the accounts receivable process, ensuring timely and accurate payment collection from customers.
build_spec.target_user: Accounting and finance teams, business owners, and financial managers.

core_capabilities.description: Generate, send, and track invoices to customers.
Monitor and record payments received from customers.
Send automated reminders to customers for overdue payments.
Facilitate communication with customers to resolve payment disputes.
Provide insights and reports on accounts receivable performance and trends.

workflow_steps.detail: Generate invoices based on customer orders and send them via email or mail.
Monitor and record payments received from customers, updating the system accordingly.
Send automated reminders to customers for overdue payments, with escalating reminders for persistent overdue accounts.
Facilitate communication with customers to resolve payment disputes, with options for adjusting invoices or providing refunds.
Provide regular reports and insights on accounts receivable performance, including metrics such as days sales outstanding (DSO) and payment trends.

integrations.purpose: Integrate with enterprise resource planning systems to access customer data and order information.
Integrate with accounting software to update financial records and reconcile payments.
Integrate with CRM systems to access customer contact information and interaction history.

suggested_tech_stack.llm: Language Model for generating invoices and automated reminders
suggested_tech_stack.orchestration: Workflow orchestration tool for managing the accounts receivable process
suggested_tech_stack.database: Relational database for storing customer data, invoice records, and payment history
integrations: APIs for integrating with ERP systems, accounting software, and CRM systems

build_spec.what_competitors_have: Basic invoice management and payment tracking capabilities, with limited automation and reporting features.
build_spec.our_differentiation: Advanced automation capabilities, including automated reminders and dispute resolution, with real-time reporting and analytics.
